decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The outbuilding constitutes unacceptable backland development, out of keeping with the existing pattern of development resulting in an over development of the site, which is considered to be harmful to the appearance of the house and the character of the area, and is harmful to neighbours' living conditions through loss of open aspect and outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development).

Condition : 2 - 2	The outbuilding has caused unsatisfactory living accommodation at 31a Ivanhoe Road due to the significant reduction in private amenity space contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development).

Condition : 3 - 3	The building is being used as residential accommodation, which provides poor quality and substandard living space with poor outlook and inadequate private garden, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development).
description: Retention of a single storey detached shed / store to rear of house
